applicant.name: Mag. Verena Strobl
applicant.organisation: VitaSecure Krankenversicherung AG, member services (private health insurer)

purpose: Our member services team needs the records for routine case management, to decide which members with depression and weight problems we contact about changes to their plan and which policies we review at renewal.
question: Provide pseudonymised conditions, medications and BMI values for adults with depression who have at least one BMI value.
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Depression = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with F32.
Cohort = adults with depression who have at least one BMI value (LOINC 39156-5).
Report the size of the cohort you would make available.

expected.reason: The stated purpose amounts to decisions detrimental to natural persons (Art. 54(a)). Access is refused (Art. 54); a refusal is always justified to the applicant (Art. 68(9)).

judge.why: Rule 1: a private insurer deciding which members to contact about plan changes and which policies to review at renewal is a detrimental insurance decision about individuals under Art. 54.
